title: DYNAMIC_REMOTE_MANAGER_AGGREGATION_FLOW_IS_NEVER_REGISTERED_OR_STARTED
acceptance: Every dynamically materialized remote-partition Manager owns an active reply aggregation flow for its complete lifetime and releases all correlated replies without leaking flows on eviction.
rootCause: CpfBatchJobFactory dynamically builds RemotePartitioningManagerStepBuilder after ApplicationContext refresh but does not provide BeanFactory. Spring Batch therefore does not register its input-channel aggregation flow. Even when registered late, the framework builder requests autoStartup(false), so CPF must explicitly own lifecycle start and cleanup for dynamically materialized jobs.
requiredFix: supply the canonical BeanFactory to every dynamic remote Manager builder
start only flows registered by that materialization
destroy owned flows when a materialized Job is evicted or creation fails
add actual flow lifecycle and aggregation regression coverage
rerun complete Java 25 Runtime, executable bootJars and Fresh physical flow
